name: downloadan
description: A fast, minimalist download manager (Tauri + Rust)
author: Hydelix

scripts.firefox:run: npm run firefox:build && web-ext run -s dist/firefox
scripts.firefox:lint: npm run firefox:build && web-ext lint -s dist/firefox
scripts.firefox:package: npm run firefox:build && web-ext build -s dist/firefox -a dist/firefox-package --overwrite-dest
